data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2017 balance) was GBP 160.397m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net favourable prior-year reserve movement of approximately GBP 5.0m (a release), largely driven by improvements on older long-tail underwriting years (2014-2016). This favourable development was reported alongside 2018 catastrophe activity (Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, Camp Fire, Hurricane Florence, Typhoon Trami) which impacted current year claims; the report also highlights the adverse impact of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in 2017 (gross c.GBP 31.5m). The prior-year release is described in the report as prior accident year releases of GBP 11.5m on a net basis.
raw_causal_phrases: prior accident year releases of GBP 11.5m mainly on long tail lines, recognising emerging experience as the Syndicate's live business matures
Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, include positive prior year development of GBP 11.5m (2017: GBP 8.7m adverse development)

Claims activity in 2018 has been impacted by catastrophe activity that was higher than planned, albeit it was the frequency of medium sized losses which did not benefit from reinsurance protection that impacted (Hurricane Michael GBP 3.5m, Typhoon Jebi GBP 2.8m, Camp fire GBP 2.8m, Hurricane Florence GBP 1.8m, Typhoon Trami GBP 1.4m)
The decrease in the net loss ratio of 60% (2017: 101%) is largely due to the impact of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in 2017 (gross impact GBP 31.5m, net GBP 12.2m)

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not given as a single gross movement figure in the notes. The prior-year movement was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 38). The report also states a net prior year release of GBP 11.5m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-derived amount; gross movement is not explicitly stated in one line. LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified by the report, so line movements are inferred and largely unquantified.
